title: Web Manga 'Ore no Shibou Flag ga Todomaru Tokoro wo Shiranai' Gets TV Anime in 2027
content: Publishing company Manga Box announced a television anime adaptation of Izumi and Mitsuya Otosu 's Ore no Shibou Flag ga Todomaru Tokoro wo Shiranai ( My Death Flags Show No Sign of Ending ) web manga on Tuesday, revealing an announcement visual (pictured above).
author: MyAnimeList

title: After Magic Knight Rayearth, This Clamp Anime Deserves a Reboot Next
content: CLAMP is a Japanese manga group known for dozens of iconic works over the decades in the anime and manga industry. Apart from this beloved action fantasy, CLAMP also created renowned manga such as Cardcaptor Sakura , Blood-C , xxxHOLiC , and many more.
author: ComicBook

title: STEEL BALL RUN JoJo's Bizarre Adventure Anime's 'Special Video' Highlights Stands
content: Warner Bros. Japan began streaming a new "special video" for the STEEL BALL RUN JoJo’s Bizarre Adventure anime on Tuesday. The video highlights the characters' Stands, the entity that manifests its owners' special abilities in the JoJo's Bizarre Adventure series.
author: ANN

title: 3 Things to Know for Spy x Family Season 4
content: Almost a year after the third season reached its conclusion, Spy x Family finally confirmed a fourth season along with a new feature-length movie. The anime premiered its latest season in October last year as part of the Fall 2025 lineup, where it adapted some of the fan-favorite arcs.
author: ComicBook

title: My Death Flags Show No Sign of Ending Novels Get TV Anime in 2027
content: Manga Box announced on Tuesday a television anime adaptation of Izumi 's My Death Flags Show No Sign of Ending ( Ore no Shibō Flag ga Todomaru Tokoro o Shiranai ) light novel series, which will debut in 2027.
author: ANN

title: Izumi Miyazono's 'Kekkon Shimashō, Koi Suru Mae ni' Manga Gets Live-Action 'Short' Drama
content: The magazine's January 2027 issue will announce more details about the drama next month. The manga centers on a girl named Natsuki, an office worker who is looking for a boyfriend and wants to get married eventually, and the office's elite lawyer who claims he is not interested in love.
author: ANN

title: After the Anime’s Success, A Classic Shojo Confirms Live-Action Series Is Coming Next
content: Hana-Kimi is commemorating its 30th anniversary with a live-action series and a stage play. While the anime’s future remains uncertain, the franchise only keeps increasing in popularity after being underrated outside of Japan.
author: ComicBook

title: Kodama Tales Licenses A Mandala in Flames, Baki Hanma, Neo Cat Manga
content: The publisher Kodama Tales announced the following manga licenses on Monday: Rejected as an apprentice by the celebrated Kano Eitoku, painter Hasegawa Tohaku struggles to establish himself in Kyoto. When he risks his life to see Eitoku's masterpieces inside a burning castle, his ambition is rekindled.
author: ANN

title: ghost – end of night Anime Film's Trailer Confirms More Cast & Staff, Theme Song
content: Bandai Namco Filmworks presented the full trailer, the second key visual, additional cast and staff members, and the theme song for ghost – end of night ( ghost/yoru no hate ), Shingo Natsume and Madhouse 's new theatrical anime project, on Tuesday. The trailer previews the theme song "life" by hitsujibungaku .
author: ANN

title: 'Ghost: Yoru no Hate' Unveils Additional Cast, Staff, Theme Song, Main Trailer
content: The official website for the Ghost: Yoru no Hate original anime movie unveiled additional cast, staff, a second key visual (pictured right), the theme song, and main trailer on Tuesday. The movie is scheduled to open in Japanese theaters on February 11, 2027.
author: MyAnimeList
